serverInfo.name: serendipity
serverInfo.title: Serendipity
serverInfo.description: Read-only access to the Serendipity event pool on aadhar.sh: community-curated events worth going to, and who's going. Public data only.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List events in the pool with a head count + RSVP tier. Defaults to events a contributor RSVP'd to/hosts (first-class, with rosters) plus a discovered_hidden count; rsvp:'all' includes browsed-not-RSVP'd events, rsvp:'discovered' only them. Args: when, rsvp, q, limit.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event in full: description, hosts, the guest list (who's going), contributors. Args: id.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Find people by name; returns role/company/socials and their events split into going_to and been_to. Args: q, limit.

tools.name: list_contributors
tools.description: List contributors feeding the pool, with an id prefix and event count.

tools.name: contributor_events
tools.description: Every event one contributor fed in, split into going_to and been_to. Args: contributor (cookie id, id prefix, or label).

tools.name: frequent_people
tools.description: Who shows up across the most events (who you're seeing a lot), with an event count. Args: when, limit.

tools.name: co_attendees
tools.description: Who one person crosses paths with most, with shared event names. Pass your own name for "who am I seeing a lot". Args: q, limit.

tools.name: connections
tools.description: The tightest co-attendance pairs pool-wide (who's seeing who), with shared counts + event names. Args: min_shared, limit.

tools.name: shared_events
tools.description: The events two named people both attended (did they cross paths, and where). Args: a, b.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Pool overview: event counts, distinct people, active contributors.
